summary: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the postponement of its special meeting of stockholders from September 3, 2026 to September 9, 2026. The delay allows more time for proxy solicitation and for stockholders to consider an amendment to Milestone Events previously disclosed in a September 1, 2026 8-K. Valid proxies remain effective unless revoked. This procedural adjournment is not a substantive special situation and does not create actionable investment dynamics.
